7f3ab889e416dbfc.column_purpose: Concatenation of term code and term name, e.g. '2010JA-January Term 2009-2010'.

0cd15d590d512fc0.column_purpose: Date shortly before the term starts (e.g. 01-DEC-09 for Jan 2010 term, 01-MAY-23 for Summer 2023), null ~4%. Plausibly a pre-registration or preparation deadline; exact meaning unresolved.

d6967b9af4975b43.column_purpose: Year code (or 'XXXX' placeholder) appearing in pairs with col_012; likely fiscal-year or academic-year-related year value. Exact semantics unresolved; 'XXXX' used for older/summer terms. No join evidence available to narrow further.

92708ba68fe56a90.column_purpose: Start-of-classes date (e.g. 17-SEP-52, two days before the official term start 19-SEP-52 for Fall 1953; equals term start for Spring/Summer terms). f79756b9d3db4339.column_purpose: Role of this person for the subject: Activity leader, Contact person, or Session leader.

b2fcc2014b9a7754.column_purpose: Person's affiliation category (Staff, Non-MIT, Research Staff, MIT Professor, Grad Student, Sophomore, etc.).

12a8a456f2366a24.column_purpose: Load/extract date of the data, constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows; likely the warehouse snapshot date rather than a business attribute.

9689f95d099d4666.column_purpose: Hexadecimal identifier of the parent IAP activity/subject; repeated across sessions of the same activity (e.g. 33 sessions for one registration-style activity). Likely joins to IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.

113255f95374c7d7.column_purpose: Optional per-session title, e.g. 'Session 4: Transmission expansion', 'Class 3: Nahre Sol'; often null when the session has no distinct title.

3955228ce560d293.column_purpose:
Optional HTML description of the individual session, e.g. '

Course Intro and Chapter 1

'.

bbc4e5542991bce0.column_purpose: Where the session is held; values are overwhelmingly virtual (Zoom, Virtual, Online) with case variations, occasionally a room/other location.

6c4727c9b4232cb6.column_purpose: Date of the session in DD-MON-YY form; values cluster in January 2021, consistent with IAP.

6b6ac0f63a51c77b.column_purpose: Session start time in HHMMAM/PM format, e.g. 0200PM = 2:00 PM.

e600caf903bdf2af.column_purpose: Session end time in HHMMAM/PM format, e.g. 0400PM = 4:00 PM.

d54b32d7439341da.column_purpose: Y/N flag, Y for 1181 of 1199 rows; plausibly whether the session is published/displayed, but the exact semantic is not directly evidenced.

84f6163b0b3fbbf5.column_purpose: Constant '19-DEC-24' on all rows; likely a snapshot/last-refresh date of the extract rather than a per-row attribute.

ebcfda34aaa29779.column_purpose: Primary key; surrogate identifier for the sponsoring organization (mixed-case hex/GUID-style values, likely from two source systems).

b4cfee118f3d6fe6.column_purpose: Name of the sponsoring organization (academic department, center, lab, student group, etc.).

568ad06bf4fb98d8.column_purpose: Category of the sponsoring organization: Academic Department, Administrative Department, Student Group, Center, Lab, or Other MIT Groups.

b14655602de7d4a7.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded/last updated; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows, suggesting a snapshot date. Could also be a source-system effective date, but a load/snapshot date is the more likely reading.

b57561c1c0b280e8.column_purpose: Primary key; opaque institution identifier. Mostly numeric strings (IPEDS UNITID-like) but also alphanumeric codes like 'F06179' for foreign institutions, so it is a mixed-scheme ID, not a pure IPEDS ID.

56c299034b5a6fa0.column_purpose: Full official name of the institution (English).

eef62f4f817c7bc0.column_purpose: Alternate/alias name of the institution; null for ~85% of rows. Could also be a branch-campus or former name; evidence does not distinguish these readings.

76e65b58fc97368c.column_purpose: Street address of the institution (first address line).

f9f212787e720a3c.column_purpose: Postal/ZIP code; populated mainly for US addresses (null for most foreign rows). Some values include ZIP+4.

1434c888144d6d81.column_purpose: US state / territory postal abbreviation (CA, FL, TX, NY, PR, ...); null for non-US institutions.

da76a9ae28ceeedf.column_purpose: Two-letter ISO country code (US, JP, CN, IN, RU, ...).

6b8f4a8e98f7cce6.column_purpose: Full country name corresponding to the ISO country code.

08a0a2d6722f7dce.column_purpose: Carnegie Classification code; -3 = 'Not applicable, not in Carnegie universe (not accredited or nondegree-granting)'. The accepted join to SPACE_USAGE.col_001 is spurious (facility room-use codes coincidentally share values) and should be ignored.

573123e6bb92a46d.column_purpose: Text label of the Carnegie Classification matching col_010 (e.g., 'Master's Colleges and Universities (larger programs)').

ec424056864b0d23.column_purpose: Three-digit FIPS 10-4 country code (900=US, 138=China, 180=India...); 999 appears for unknown/unclassified. Counts match col_008/col_009 country frequencies.

1e415144bb7f3deb.column_purpose: Date the institution record was loaded/last updated, in DD-MON-YY form; most rows date from 17-JUL-14 with a refresh on 16-JUL-24. Could be a snapshot date rather than a row-level update date.

78e9ad6eb54fa774.column_purpose: Primary key. Composite string of course number, instructor surname, and term code, plus the course number again after a colon (e.g. '6.002-WATERS2012FA:6.002'). Uniquely identifies a course-reserve record.

192af6a48b286b71.column_purpose: Title of the course placed on reserve (e.g. 'Calculus', 'Introduction to Topology').

31b7ba80409e431c.column_purpose: Instructor of the course, in 'Last, First' format.

d5c956681bf3566c.column_purpose: Department offering the course, as MIT course number and name (e.g. '21F - Foreign Languages/Literatures', '18 - Mathematics') or plain department name.

a18e6119168201a4.column_purpose: Start date of the academic term, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. '06-SEP-11').

289fce4dce614d81.column_purpose: End date of the academic term, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. '22-DEC-11'). Some values like '31-MAY-31' look like placeholder/far-future dates.

7a9a284b84ff3dd9.column_purpose: Code of the MIT library branch holding the reserve (Hayden, ENG=Barker Engineering, DEW=Dewey, RTC=Rotch, MUS=Lewis Music). Null when no library assignment. Values like 'Hayden & ENG' indicate multiple branches.

4a784f17ba55ce1d.column_purpose: Full name of the library branch corresponding to col_007 (Hayden, Barker, Dewey, Rotch, Lewis Music). Null when no library assignment.

9ba7a76ddc0a3c60.column_purpose: Date the reserve expires or is removed, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format; typically near the end of the term (e.g. '22-NOV-12', '09-MAY-12').

15c5a3065863cfd5.column_purpose: One-letter code classifying a library reserve material's status (Y, U, R, O, N, X). Primary key; referenced by LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.col_004. Exact letter meanings beyond those implied by col_003 (N = Non-Required, O = Reserve only, U = Unknown) are not fully determinable.

a45cf6c4162955fd.column_purpose: Duplicate of col_001 (identical values in every row); the join to LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.col_004 points at col_001, not this column. Likely a display or copy of the status code; its separate purpose is unclear.

132b854dc44700e7.column_purpose: Human-readable description of the status: 'Required Course Material', 'Reserve only', 'No Required Textbook', 'Non-Required Course Material', 'Unknown'. One row has a null description (likely the X or Y code).

4b3f2389e77d1b3f.column_purpose: Date the lookup was last updated; all rows show 23-DEC-21. Format DD-MON-YY suggests an Oracle-style date stored as text. Alternative reading: a generic effective/audit date column; no join evidence to disambiguate.

90951e2e08f2b6c6.column_purpose: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for the reserve catalog record.

6756ddba37ca6e94.column_purpose: Item title (library catalog style, 'Title / Author'). Some rows instead contain course cross-listing notes ('This course is cross-listed with ...'), so the field holds a general title/note for the reserve entry.

e01fdf85e5e8b5e3.column_purpose: Author statement in catalog format (e.g. 'Shakespeare, William, 1564-1616.').

5182fc45ed940a35.column_purpose: Year of publication; 0 means unknown/missing. Values 1960-2020.

0d51764b47318b05.column_purpose: Imprint (place : publisher, date) of the item.

4d8e203e8bb71722.column_purpose: Library call number (mostly LC class numbers like QA303.S5547 1996), with some special values like 'Professor Collection', 'Personal Copy', 'RESERVE VIDEO' indicating non-cataloged reserve copies.

56544e73fb286e0c.column_purpose: ISBN/ISSN of the item, sometimes with qualifiers like '(pbk.)' or '(alk. paper)'.

63f381a4763a15f8.column_purpose: Duplicate of col_001 (identical values and distribution); likely a foreign key back to the same record or a redundant copy of the ID.

ca5d6f7e9ef03c02.column_purpose: Date the item was placed on reserve (Oracle DD-MON-YY format).

89f4d6379a8cd187.column_purpose: Date the item was taken off reserve; the dominant value 02-FEB-09 suggests a bulk removal/reload event.

71095703cf537090.column_purpose: Date the record was last updated/loaded; dominant values (13-MAR-08, 03-FEB-09) look like batch update dates.

5ea248b1d3786522.column_purpose: Composite key of the form <subject>-<instructor><term>:<subject>, e.g. '21M.262-PALMER2009FA:21M.262'. Identifies the course-reserve record (course, instructor, term) that this material belongs to. Not unique because a course can have multiple reserve materials.

7f76295eec52309e.column_purpose: Numeric identifier (range ~1356-60836) for the reserve material item, presumably joining to LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG (no accepted join detected, so the exact target is tentative). Not unique; the same catalog item can appear for multiple course/term records.

bd1c68fdaae7833d.column_purpose: Subject code concatenated with term code, e.g. '21M.2622009FA' — identifies the course offering (subject + term) for this reserve material.

e23237565f61e17f.column_purpose: Code indicating whether the material is required for the course, per LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lookup: U=Unknown, N=Non-Required Course Material, O=Reserve only, X=No Required Textbook, Y=Required Course Material.

c7788a46fc0ba64f.column_purpose: Academic term code (e.g. 2009FA, 2008SP, 2009JA, 2008SU) in which the reserve material was assigned; references ACADEMIC_TERMS / ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

26496d2c125c24df.column_purpose: MIT subject/course code (e.g. 21M.240, HST.S11, 4.286) of the course the reserve material is for.

db8916d731e1089f.column_purpose: End date of the term (Oracle DD-MON-YY format), constant per term code (e.g. 2009FA -> 05-DEC-08, 2009SP -> 08-MAY-09). Could alternatively be a reserve-list expiration date, but the per-term constancy supports term end date.

bf39ade4aea06c41.column_purpose: Primary key: concatenation of subject number and term code (e.g. '10.543' + '2014SP'), uniquely identifying a subject offering in a term.

2299cc8d13700b9e.column_purpose: Academic term code (YYYY + FA/SP/SU/JA for fall/spring/summer/IAP). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

2dfe1a7f073d0d78.column_purpose: Course/subject code of the subject's catalog department (e.g. 15=Management, 21F=Foreign Languages). References SIS_SUBJECT_CODE / STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.

79c17e30ba43de8d.column_purpose: Same as col_003 but right-padded/left-padded to fixed width (leading spaces).

549633e5428596af.column_purpose: Department name corresponding to col_003 (e.g. 15 -> Management).

43811cad97f533d5.column_purpose: Same subject number as col_006, padded variant.

1aa3761ab0e1dd74.column_purpose: Code of the department administering/offering the subject (may differ from catalog department). References STUDENT_DEPARTMENT / SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.

ef57dd16bd49a17b.column_purpose: Name of the administering department (corresponds to col_008).

9624403a1f691daf.column_purpose: Full subject number including suffixes (e.g. 18.100B, 21G.S05); slightly more distinct values than col_006.

67bc0fecc9d590d3.column_purpose: Department code of the unit offering/administering the subject; references SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.department_code (and STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.department_code). Sample values match col_008 (admin_department_code), so it may simply be a duplicate of that column sourced from a different (newer) naming table; an alternative reading is a distinct 'offering unit' code that usually coincides with the administering department.

d33cd809e9df42c5.column_purpose: Name corresponding to col_014; note 'Global Studies & Languages' vs col_010's 'Foreign Languages/Literatures' for 21F, suggesting a different (newer) department naming source.

84a21cd18bc4055d.column_purpose: MIT school the subject belongs to (Engineering, Science, Sloan, Architecture and Planning, Hum/Arts/Social Sciences).

7acf97302a23edb6.column_purpose: Instructor of the subject offering, formatted 'Last, First'.

2325cd900f6c83ab.column_purpose: Numeric identifier (MIT ID-like, 9-digit) of the instructor; pairs with col_017.

4cc6d9c16e07679f.column_purpose: Enrollment count for the subject offering (integer, 0-673).

313f4b4d84017df4.column_purpose: Date the data was extracted/loaded ('19-DEC-24'), constant across all rows.

7a88ca46962d9319.column_purpose: Numeric identifier for the department/DLC, the numeric counterpart of the D-code (col_002). Primary key; unique per row. Referenced implicitly by hierarchy tables via the D-code.

1a9756f3507c4e2b.column_purpose: Department/DLC code (e.g., D_AEROASTRO, D_MTL), prefixed 'D_'. Canonical key referenced by MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY_LINKS, HR_ORG_UNIT, SIS_DEPARTMENT, facilities and space tables.

2a95a952d87e9be4.column_purpose: Full name of the department, lab, or center (e.g., 'Whitehead Institute', 'Office of Experiential Learning').

5f1f1890170137fd.column_purpose: Numeric identifier of the parent (top-level) organizational unit; values match col_001 values of parent rows (e.g., 12259 = School of Engineering). 31 distinct parents.

20a3121656487140.column_purpose: D-code of the parent/top-level organizational unit (e.g., D_SCHOOL_ENG, D_VPRES). Pairs with col_004.

5adb2d1a02af2b9f.column_purpose: Name of the parent/top-level organizational unit (e.g., 'School of Engineering', 'VP Research').

c3c95c26da0d6251.column_purpose: Date of the data extract/snapshot, constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows; indicates this table reflects the hierarchy as of 19 December 2024.

a5b000ea95383311.column_purpose: Name of the hierarchy this row belongs to; constant 'Standard Hierarchy' for all rows.

5008a49b5eb5a93a.column_purpose: Primary key. Department (DLC) code, e.g. D_PSFC, D_MATHS, D_AEROASTRO. Canonical department identifier referenced by many other tables.

c3bf950ea5103508.column_purpose: Duplicate of the department code (col_002); identical values in all rows. Possibly a display/alternate-key copy.

e9ca3c4b7fc19f12.column_purpose: Full name of the department/unit, e.g. 'Plasma Sciences & Fusion Center', 'Mathematics'.

ef3063537092c21c.column_purpose: Code of the top-level hierarchy node; constant 'D_ALL' for all rows.

c343c2ca48367e52.column_purpose: Name of the top-level hierarchy node; constant 'All Departments'.

e812b204893608b0.column_purpose: Code of the senior-officer area the department reports to (e.g. D_PROVOST_AREA, D_EXECVP_AREA, D_PRES_AREA).

47baddae0084b4ab.column_purpose: Name of the senior-officer area, e.g. 'Provost Area', "Executive Vice President's Area".

6e237fd684490cba.column_purpose: Code of the intermediate grouping (school or VP area) the department belongs to, e.g. D_SCHOOL_ENG, D_VPRES, D_DSL. Null when no grouping applies.

1f7d63ed77a43209.column_purpose: Name of the intermediate grouping, e.g. 'School of Engineering', 'VP Research', 'Dean for Student Life'. Nulls align with col_009.

dfe6b6323da6ca20.column_purpose: Code of a finer sub-grouping level; populated only for a few departments (D_OSATT_AREA, D_SOURCING_AREA), otherwise null. Joins to MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT's dept_dcode, so it is a D_-prefixed hierarchy code, but the join evidence does not distinguish whether it is a sub-grouping code or a parent-area code; the sparse population pattern supports the sub-grouping reading.

53f5df7d8242abf3.column_purpose: Name of the sub-grouping level ('Office of Strategic Alliances & Tech Transfer Area', 'Sourcing Area'); nulls align with col_011. Alternative reading: name of a parent area rather than a sub-grouping, since the paired code joins to the canonical D-code lookup.

1631593e4e22b3bf.column_purpose: Name of the hierarchy the link belongs to; constant 'Standard Hierarchy' in all rows.

c1e5184fecfdaa1e.column_purpose: Code identifying the hierarchy/source system of the node: FC (funds center), PMIT (PCMIT-0 profit center), ORG2 (new org unit), ORG (old org unit), BAG (NIMBUS B.A.G.), SIS, FORG. Exact meanings of SIS/FORG unresolved.

b6e6f91d5c312a62.column_purpose: Human-readable label of the hierarchy type corresponding to col_002 (e.g. 'Standard Funds Center', 'PCMIT-0 Profit Center', 'New Org. Unit', 'Old Org. Unit', 'NIMBUS B.A.G.').

576f1ad2c9dd532a.column_purpose: Parent department code (D_ prefixed, e.g. D_EECS, D_MECHE) in the master department hierarchy; references MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY / MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT.

6ec4cce6b94ff3f0.column_purpose: Department code of the linked node; references MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.department_code and MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT.dept_dcode. Identical to col_004 in samples, so parent vs child assignment between col_004/col_005 is uncertain — it may be a duplicate of the parent department code rather than a distinct child.

dc83744aba658132.column_purpose: Identifier of the hierarchy node being linked (e.g. funds center codes FC_CEE58, FC203103, profit center P151080-001). Nearly unique per row.

8fd13b91fd4d9d48.column_purpose: Same value as col_006 in all observed rows; likely a redundant copy of the node/funds-center identifier. Whether it ever differs is unresolved.

f0bcd5be9f7f9abf.column_purpose: Date of the holiday/closing, stored as text in DD-MON-YY Oracle format (e.g. 25-NOV-27 = Nov 25, 2027). Primary key; a few dates appear twice (e.g. two closings on the same date, such as New Year's Day and Christmas overlapping 01-JAN/25-DEC across years).

654a2de4ba3814ef.column_purpose: Name of the holiday/closing, e.g. 'MIT Christmas Day', 'MIT Patriots' Day', 'MIT Day After Thanksgiving'. Some rows contain short codes instead: 'EMER' (86 rows, matching Emergency Closing) and 'SHOL' (62 rows, matching Special Holiday/Closing) — likely 'Emergency' and 'Special Holiday' codes whose full labels were not populated.

f0512123f98f6e4a.column_purpose: Category of the closing: 'Standard Holiday' (432), 'Emergency Closing' (86, matches EMER rows), 'Special Holiday/Closing' (62, matches SHOL rows).

50f8af9b48af869c.column_purpose: Constant value '19-DEC-24' on every row; almost certainly the date the table/snapshot was loaded or last refreshed rather than an attribute of the closing. No other evidence to confirm its exact semantics.

aa040487713c3e40.column_purpose: Student's middle name or middle initial (single letters like 'H', 'B', 'M' are initials; full names also appear). Null for ~58% of students.

aa4b782329480314.column_purpose: Display name in 'Last, First [Middle]' format, e.g. 'Mann, Nina'.

24f362367ab0165e.column_purpose: MIT building-room code (e.g. 'E15-381D', '26-226D') for the student's office/lab room; populated for only ~3.6% of rows (likely grad students with offices).

4212667bfe766c64.column_purpose: A phone number stored as digits (10-digit values, some longer, possibly with country/extension digits). Populated for only ~0.5% of rows; exact type (office vs. mobile) unresolved.

4bf28fb47bd41cbe.column_purpose: Student's email address (synthetic domain 'worker.com' in this data).

f88236e729bd669a.column_purpose: MIT course/department number code (e.g. '6' = EECS, '15' = Management, '16' = AeroAstro); references STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.col_001.

d7a3264d336d0f5b.column_purpose: Human-readable department name corresponding to the department code (denormalized label from STUDENT_DEPARTMENT).

7af4ef7a2d14e10e.column_purpose: Class-year code: 'G' for graduate students (62.75%), '1'-'4' for undergraduate freshman through senior classes.

548cc36bc0617574.column_purpose: Uppercase version of the full display name ('LAST, FIRST [MIDDLE]'), likely used for sorting/searching.

83806959c5549953.column_purpose: Date the directory snapshot was taken, '19-DEC-24' for all rows (DD-MON-YY format).

e515f226c868a1ea.column_purpose: Name of the Moira list. Unique per row (8815 distinct in 10000 rows, with a few names repeated). Values are word-pair/triplet strings, likely anonymized stand-ins for real list names. Joins to MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL / MOIRA_LIST_OWNER conceptually, though no detected joins.

f30ee209de875330.column_purpose: Exact duplicate of col_001 in every sampled row and identical value distribution; likely a second copy of the list name (e.g. a display/canonical name column that mirrors the key). Could also be a separate field that happens to equal the list name, but duplicate-copy is the best-supported reading.

23cd88e80d24a907.column_purpose: Single-valued Y flag on every row. Constantly 'Y', so its meaning cannot be distinguished from other always-true flags (e.g. active, enabled, visible). Marked tentative: it is a boolean flag that is always set, consistent with an 'active' indicator for lists in this extract.

146fb5e181bdace3.column_purpose: Name of the Moira mailing list whose membership this row records (e.g. 'orange-rabbit'). Moira is MIT's list/account management system.

1cd6950c523fd55a.column_purpose: Type-prefixed member reference: values starting 'LIST' indicate a nested list included as a member, values starting 'USER' indicate an individual user, followed by the list or user name. The exact semantics of the suffix (e.g. 'LIST41.863-dancer-courage') are unclear; it may be a list name or a composite key.

52e69b276826779a.column_purpose: Identifier of the list member: either an email address (e.g. 'hr@yahoo.com') or a username/handle (e.g. 'athenah').

bd021fe84d1e7432.column_purpose: Full name of the list member in 'Last, First' format; null when the member is an email address or list without a known person record.

87684b67d0cf6309.column_purpose: 9-digit MIT personal ID number of the member; null when the member has no person record (e.g. external email addresses or nested lists).

5bf56eeec4f16891.column_purpose: Date the member was added to the list, in DD-MON-YY Oracle format.

c8b92dc4f743e451.column_purpose: Flag indicating the membership is active; constant value 1 in this extract.

6fbebe118bd47618.column_purpose: Date the row was extracted/loaded into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows, i.e. the snapshot date.

49c8571177ec2fa5.column_purpose: Primary key. The owned entity's name prefixed by its Moira type: 'LIST' + list name (e.g. 'LISTbeacon-panda'). For USER/KERBEROS rows the prefix would differ. Values are anonymized/synthetic list names (word-word or number-word-word patterns).

c4e5b0050c75ac26.column_purpose: The unqualified name of the owned entity (list name or username), i.e. col_001 without the type prefix. Same anonymized word/number patterns as col_001.

947e000641d146e1.column_purpose: Moira entity type of the owner: LIST (a list owns another list, 7646 rows), USER (a person/user account, 2349 rows), KERBEROS (a Kerberos principal, 5 rows).

03c776bd15eb4c93.column_purpose: Date of the data extract/snapshot; constant '19-DEC-24' (December 19, 2024) across all rows. Not a per-row business date.

d39d7993dde7b98d.column_purpose: Person identifier, apparently a Kerberos/username-style ID (e.g. JESSEH7, RIYAC, ELSPETHH). Not unique in this extract (5330 distinct over 10000 rows), so it is not a primary key here; possibly duplicated across snapshot dates or area rows.

940605a58c1b2c46.column_purpose: Date of the data extract/snapshot, constant '19-DEC-24' (December 19, 2024) for all rows. Not a per-row business date.

8b9f4f1a4231be39.column_purpose: MIT username (Kerberos-style, e.g. luisar, aaliyahk) of the person holding the role. Repeats across rows because a user can have roles for multiple departments.

292eab531c85ff21.column_purpose: Department code prefixed with 'D_' (e.g. D_MECHE = Mechanical Engineering, D_CHEME = Chemical Engineering, D_BIOLOGY = Biology). Joins to MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT and MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY, confirming it is a department identifier.

e22ce6d9ffadd935.column_purpose: 9-digit MIT personal identifier (primary key, unique across all rows).

859d08eb2c8be2ac.column_purpose: MIT Kerberos/Athena username, typically first name + last initial (e.g. staceyk, savannahc).

14a12b8366d257ea.column_purpose: Display name in 'Last, First' format; some rows include middle name or suffix.

241c974e54e257dc.column_purpose: Detailed HR appointment/employee classification (e.g. Grad Std Fellow, Admin Staff, Dept Hd/Dir-Ten, Inst Professors).

83e7e2e514140100.column_purpose: Single-valued 'Y' flag, likely an active/current-record indicator; constant so meaning not fully provable.

bea98f9c9481c3f1.column_purpose: MIT building-room office location code (e.g. E23, 5-172F, NW12-264G); null for ~37% (no assigned office).

231864787d89942b.column_purpose: Home department or organizational unit name (e.g. Electrical Engineering-Computer Science, MIT Sloan Finance).

8d46c99b46d3d2df.column_purpose: Middle name or middle initial; null for ~53% of rows.

dfc13f465df75543.column_purpose: Broad person classification group (Student, Faculty, Admin Staff, Support Staff, Sponsored Research Staff, Medical, etc.).

71d09b8787a92b3a.column_purpose: Snapshot/extract date of the table load; constant '19-DEC-24' on all rows.

f8bda0b6c6fbfa9b.column_purpose: Primary key: MIT department/administrative unit code (e.g. AERO, 21F, 15D, BAP). Referenced by subject, course catalog, and student degree program tables.

e034861286af4f53.column_purpose: Full name/description of the department or administrative unit (e.g. 'Baptist Ministry', 'School of Engineering Office', 'Biological Engineering Div.').

cee3b8c6dc867f55.column_purpose: 7-digit financial account number (likely cost/account number) associated with the department; null for most administrative units. Exact account type not determinable.

b159221f382652bb.column_purpose: 7-digit secondary financial account number (values cluster around 1.1M-1.6M, some ~3.9M); possibly a cost object or fund account. Exact meaning not determinable.

58153a8e907d3c43.column_purpose: Date the department record was created or last made effective (Oracle-style DD-MON-YY dates, mostly 1990s-2000s). Could be a last-update date; creation date is the more likely reading given the historical values.

00dbeb4269d11092.column_purpose: MIT degree abbreviation: SB, SM, DOC, MNG, MCP, MBA, HA, etc.; 'NDG' = no degree granted.

fca3987c1061bd70.column_purpose: Degree level: 'Masters' or 'Doctoral'; null for non-degree/undergraduate rows. Duplicates col_020.

ae42edb38d3de171.column_purpose: Duplicate of col_019: 'Masters' or 'Doctoral', null otherwise.

1874a3a63bd7661b.column_purpose: Date the record was last updated, DD-MON-YY format (e.g. '23-JUL-15').

bbca8aa0a3cfa439.column_purpose: Warehouse extract/load date; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows.

38fe40c4979fd55d.column_purpose: Short department code (e.g. '21F' Foreign Languages & Literatures, 'ARC', 'HASS', 'ODGE' Office of the Dean for Graduate Education). Nearly unique (127 distinct of 128, one null); likely the natural key of the table.

bb3603b7575ff34d.column_purpose: Concatenated code and name ('1-Civil and Environmental Eng', '21L-Literature'), unique per row; the join key referenced by STUDENT_DEPARTMENT and SUBJECT_GROUPING.

31d61a390705a617.column_purpose: Single-letter code for the department's group/school category; pairs with col_005 (Y=MIT academic, E=Engineering, H=Humanities/Arts/Social Sciences, Z=Non-MIT, X=MIT non-academic).

0acccef761595c3b.column_purpose: Label for the group code: 'MIT, academic', 'Engineering', 'Hum, Arts & Social Sciences', 'Non-MIT', 'MIT, non-academic', plus college-level labels (Whitaker/HST, Schwarzman).

842ab26c84f289b4.column_purpose: Numeric identifier (30000-446900) resembling an MIT organizational/HR unit or cost-center number; null for non-MIT units. Exact system of reference unresolved (no accepted join).

2baf9ea779199071.column_purpose: Y/N flag, likely whether the department is currently active/valid in SIS. Y/N meaning is plausible but not directly evidenced.

de45e70b41beb1b6.column_purpose: Full formal department name ('Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics', 'Program in System Design and Management'); null for over half the rows where the short name suffices.

b2db345fd053f965.column_purpose: MIT school the department belongs to (School of Engineering, School of Science, School of Humanities, Arts, and Social Sciences, School of Architecture and Planning, Sloan, Schwarzman College of Computing, Whitaker College of HST).

49e623d4465380a5.column_purpose: D_-prefixed department hierarchy/grouping code (D_CROSS_REG, D_DHSS, D_BIOENG...) referencing MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY and MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT, defining the department's place in the reporting hierarchy.

fdc7bc3ef01b3570.column_purpose: Constant '19-DEC-24' on all rows: date the data was loaded/refreshed into the warehouse.

e5cf72e869f86f63.column_purpose: The lookup domain/classification the code belongs to, e.g. 'Registration Status', 'Enrollment Status', 'Load Level', 'Registration Group', 'Registration Type'. One odd value 'HGN' appears in samples and is unresolved (possibly a category code or data error).

3d47315945e4df16.column_purpose: Short SIS code within its category (e.g. RE = Registered, N = New Regular Grad Student, ET = Early Thesis, DN = Dropped No Tuition). Not unique across categories, so it is only meaningful together with col_001.

d045812f81679fcf.column_purpose: Human-readable label/meaning of the code, e.g. 'Registered', 'Not for graduate credit', 'Dropped, No Tuition', '3/4 Time'. One row has '?' as its label (unresolved placeholder).

a5a0f4f3a3e23dee.column_purpose: Date the lookup was extracted/last updated; constant '19-DEC-24' (19 December 2024) in all 67 rows. Format DD-MON-YY.

d7fd88ef04e5a240.column_purpose: Primary key. MIT subject code (course number prefix), e.g. '11' (Urban Studies and Planning), 'MCI', 'MCK', '21F', 'SMS'. Values are unique across 221 rows and are referenced by many subject-offering tables.

6cda9bdd23ab19a8.column_purpose: Duplicate of col_001 (subject code); identical values, uniqueness, and join profile. Likely a redundant copy of the primary key, possibly from a source-system export.

2346f101d4f5b0ff.column_purpose: Full descriptive name of the subject/course area, e.g. 'Urban Studies and Planning', 'History of Art', 'Studio for Interrelated Media'. Some values mark discontinued or external subjects ('Harvard, old', 'Old subjects', 'Wellesley, old').

cb13dc141aadc216.column_purpose: Code of the department that owns the subject; references STUDENT_DEPARTMENT / SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT (e.g. '12' = Earth, Atmos & Planetary Sci, '15' = Management, '1' = Civil and Environmental Eng). 9803af484d8be15d.column_purpose: Name of the owning department corresponding to col_004, e.g. 'Urban Studies and Planning', 'Non-Institute-MFA/MCA', 'Wellesley Cross-Enrollment Pro'.

c1b75683a99cb4fc.column_purpose: Code for the school/area classification of the subject: 'Z' (Non-MIT), 'E' (Engineering), 'H' (Hum, Arts & Social Sciences), 'S' (Science), 'A' (Architecture and Planning), etc.

e4c353d241c77e07.column_purpose: Name of the school/area corresponding to col_006, e.g. 'Non-MIT', 'Engineering', 'Hum, Arts & Social Sciences', 'Architecture and Planning', 'Whitaker Coll of HST; HST', 'Schwarzman Coll of Comp'.

288dda7592e93d9e.column_purpose: Constant date value '19-DEC-24' on every row; appears to be the date the snapshot/extract was loaded (warehouse load date), not a per-row attribute. No joins provide further evidence, so this reading remains plausible but unconfirmed.

6f14039813b2fe31.column_purpose: Primary key: short alphanumeric code identifying a term-address category (e.g. PKA = pika, WGA = Westgate, VAS, PKT, SAE, NUD, PBP). 00ffced9c7bf3865.column_purpose: Human-readable name of the address category: dormitory names (Westgate Lowrise, Graduate Junction), fraternity/sorority names (Kappa Alpha Theta, Kappa Sigma, Alpha Phi, Theta Delta Chi, Delta Psi), ILGs (pika), and street addresses (405 Memorial Dr, Cambridge 02139). babc524ed3c2375e.column_purpose: Single-letter code for the category type: D = Dormitory, F = Fraternity, S = Sorority, I = ILG (Independent Living Group), O = Off Campus. Mapping confirmed by col_004 correspondence. Nulls (8%) correspond to rows where the type is 'Unknown'.

a044b45d4601c7fa.column_purpose: Text description of the category type: Dormitory, Fraternity, Sorority, ILG, Off Campus, or Unknown. Pairs 1:1 with col_003 (D/F/S/I/O), with 'Unknown' covering the 9 rows where col_003 is null.

2891362b7cae05f0.column_purpose: Date (stored as text, DD-MON-YY Oracle format) the category became effective/active. '01-JAN-60' is a default/placeholder date. Most dates cluster in the 1990s when the list was set up, with a few recent additions (e.g. 06-OCT-23 for Graduate Junction).

85a031d7d94d63b3.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY text) the category expired/was retired; null for ~85% of rows, i.e. still active. Non-null values (e.g. 01-JAN-15, 01-JAN-94) mark discontinued categories. Could alternatively be a 'date removed from use' audit field, but expiration is the standard reading.

c0300ae9a7e19e63.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY text) the row was last modified/added. Values track the effective dates plus later updates (e.g. 20-SEP-24 for the newly added Graduate Junction).

563cc14bc17c6a18.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY text) the row was loaded/refreshed into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' across all 112 rows, indicating the last full extract.

e53b490fdec369aa.column_purpose: Building number (campus building identifier). Its value distribution exactly matches col_010 (top values 32, 36, 13, 10, 3) and sample rows agree, so it duplicates the building number. The detected join to SPACE_USAGE is almost certainly a statistical coincidence, not a real reference.

8fe0145cef16acae.column_purpose: Floor code within the building (e.g. '2', '4', 'D6', 'G6', '0000' for basement/ground levels). References SPACE_FLOOR lookup, where labels are like '27 Floor', 'D8 Floor'.

a691f91eeeb2183c.column_purpose: Code of the department / DLC (space unit) that occupies or owns the room, e.g. 591000, 271000, 417500. References SPACE_UNIT.

87f15dc97dcffdee.column_purpose: Room use / room type code (1-87), referencing SPACE_USAGE, whose labels are room types like 'CLNT MEETING ROOM', 'MED ROOM', 'DINING RM', 'LIBRARY'.

706428f7e7bd2e92.column_purpose: Full room identifier in 'building-room' form, e.g. '10-436E', '32-276'. Nearly unique per row (uniqueness 0.933; a few rooms appear in multiple rows).

5b6c049615d2308a.column_purpose: Duplicate of col_005 (same values in all samples, same distribution) - full room identifier 'building-room'.

a8c5779af843cb7d.column_purpose: Truncated room number: the last 2-3 characters of the room number (10-436E -> '36E', 13-294B -> '94B', 32-276 -> '76'). Possibly a padded/short room-number field; exact purpose unclear. No joined evidence available to confirm another reading.

dd6575708dfcd765.column_purpose: Room area, almost certainly in square feet (values 1 to 108,475, median 147, consistent with individual room sizes).

273f5a623d606078.column_purpose: Constant value 1 for all rows; likely an 'active/current record' flag, but with no variation and no joined evidence the meaning cannot be confirmed.

b1e48e7a500ec257.column_purpose: Building number, referencing FAC_BUILDING / FCLT_BUILDING (e.g. '10', '13', '32', with a few alpha-suffixed codes like '42T').

ba1076e639acf8ef.column_purpose: Snapshot/extract date of the data; constant '19-DEC-24' (December 19, 2024) across all rows, indicating this is a point-in-time extract.

0a7b485068fd8717.column_purpose: Primary key: floor code (e.g. '0000', '27', 'D6', 'G9'). Referenced by room tables to identify the floor a room is on.

309cb5e734e0d366.column_purpose: Duplicate of col_001 (identical values in all rows); likely a second copy of the floor code, possibly from a join or view definition.

f554eb075be866b5.column_purpose: Display label for the floor, the floor code plus ' Floor' (e.g. '27 Floor', 'D4 Floor').

6a68840ff6ec4eb8.column_purpose: Constant value '19-DEC-24' on every row; appears to be a snapshot/extract date for the whole lookup rather than a per-row attribute. Ambiguous between the date the data was extracted and the as-of date of the snapshot; no join evidence distinguishes the two readings.

2be403c1699e39fd.column_purpose: Primary key; unique numeric identifier (9-digit) for each space usage record.

45bd06bc6e882002.column_purpose: Sequence/line number within a record group; almost always 1, occasionally 2-4, suggesting multiple allocation lines per space. Alternative reading: a sub-line index splitting one room's usage across multiple room-use types.

b9564d1131522cd8.column_purpose: MIT DLC (department, lab, or center) code(s) responsible for the space; values like D_LIBRARIES, D_SLOAN, D_EAPS; can be comma-separated for shared space.

07137a81e82af834.column_purpose: Room/space area in square feet (0 to ~215,723; median 159).

e95faf94fd54f429.column_purpose: Assigned/usable square footage; closely tracks room_area_sqft (same top values and max), likely the area credited to the DLC after adjustments. Alternative reading: a duplicate copy of the room area rather than a distinct assigned measure.

b6221b456517f9e8.column_purpose: Organization/DLC number (e.g. 874100, 401812) identifying the unit in facilities and space systems; referenced by SPACE_DETAIL, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD, FAC/FCLT_ORGANIZATION and other space tables. Duplicates col_003.

63b8409a23d34a5e.column_purpose: Exact duplicate of col_002 (same values, same joins): the organization number of the space unit.

4b31c7bcb37c26c0.column_purpose: Department code (D_ prefix) for the unit, e.g. D_MECHE, D_AVS; joins to MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY and MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT department hierarchy tables.

ccf3185cb0266467.column_purpose: Constant value '19-DEC-24' on all rows: the date this extract/snapshot of the space unit list was taken. Could also be a last-updated date; the constant value supports snapshot date more strongly.

7d1c14681413ee1f.column_purpose: Identical duplicate of col_001 (same values, same statistics) — the same space unit code stored twice, likely a legacy or join-convenience column.

67151aa250f0e28e.column_purpose: Name of the space unit (e.g. LITERATURE, MCGOVERN INSTITUTE, CAREER SERVICES). Joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION's organization name.

881f3d7afd0c3859.column_purpose: MIT department code prefixed with 'D_' (e.g. D_LIT, D_MECHE, D_CHANCELLOR), linking the space unit to the master department hierarchy. Null for ~5% of units (likely non-departmental units).

abb8bc0c04563265.column_purpose: Date the snapshot was taken/loaded, '19-DEC-24' on every row. Format is DD-MON-YY; stored as text.

bd45647ac0eb075a.column_purpose: Primary key: numeric identifier for the space usage category. Referenced by space tables (SPACE_DETAIL, SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE) as a foreign key; the many other statistical joins to unrelated tables are spurious.

51d7c4fa36d6aba5.column_purpose: Short label of the space usage category, e.g. 'RSRC RM' (resource room), 'RESEARCH CENTER', 'DSGN STUDIO' (design studio), 'TRNG RM' (training room), 'DINING RM' (dining room).

3119cb960434c037.column_purpose: Date value '19-DEC-24' present on every row; likely the date the reference data was loaded or last updated (snapshot date). a500f07f7d6496ba.column_purpose: Unique short code for the degree program (e.g. PHD, SMWS12, SB10B, SM15MT). Not fully unique here (357 distinct / 1202 rows), likely because rows also vary by effective term.

a93d37fdc3232418.column_purpose: Full official long name of the degree program (e.g. 'Doctor of Philosophy', 'Bachelor of Science in Chemical-Biological Engineering').

e96ea2887a1e8d58.column_purpose: Alternate/abbreviated official description of the degree program; same meaning as col_002 but with shortened wording (e.g. 'w/o spec of field').

47dcf0907af7fe12.column_purpose: Abbreviated degree-level code: SB (Bachelor), SM (Master of Science), PHD, SCD, ENG, MBA, MCP, etc.

121efdebcabf8e8c.column_purpose: Full name of the degree level corresponding to col_004 (e.g. 'Master of Science', 'Bachelor of Science').

64fcca3a6b4524ce.column_purpose: Code of the administering academic department (MIT course number, e.g. 12 = Earth, Atmospheric & Planetary Sciences, 6 = EECS, 15 = Management). Joins to STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.

c34a5f62312dc92d.column_purpose: Full name of the administering department/school/program (e.g. 'Department of Mechanical Engineering', 'Sloan School of Management').

71f2dc5718695baa.column_purpose: MIT school the program belongs to (School of Engineering, School of Science, etc.).

ab7efed78129f1e2.column_purpose: Course/curriculum designation combining MIT course number and option letter (e.g. '2 M', '10 B', '21 CMS'). Corresponds to col_015 in coded form; no join evidence available, so this reading remains tentative.

8ee8a31fe1485e97.column_purpose: Undergraduate vs graduate indicator: 'U' = undergraduate (all SB rows), 'G' = graduate.

2f7ac390fd1a640f.column_purpose: Y/N flag; likely indicates a joint or special program (e.g. MIT-WHOI joint degrees). Exact criterion not directly evidenced and no join evidence is available, so this reading remains tentative.

c4ccac71196bb1e0.column_purpose: MIT course designation in roman numerals (Course XII, Course VI-P, Course X-B), i.e. the curriculum the degree is granted under.

5b3b4bc40fd52527.column_purpose: Combined display string of degree abbreviation and course (e.g. 'S.M., Without Spec.', 'Ph.D., Course VII').

8376396eccdd057c.column_purpose: Date the degree program record became effective, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format.

114643dcbc7bfce0.column_purpose: Date the degree program record expired, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format.

081b4d5bd7386776.column_purpose: Constant value '19-DEC-24' on all rows; date the data was extracted/loaded from the source system.

1f3bef9fed366e85.column_purpose: Primary key: MIT course/department number code (e.g. '1' = Civil & Environmental Engineering, '12' = EAPS, '21L' = Literature) or special code for non-degree/exchange programs ('NIV', 'NIT' = Tufts Cross-Enrollment, 'WCD', 'CSB'). Referenced by many student, subject, and course tables.

0fd07008f966ce2f.column_purpose: Full descriptive name of the department or program (e.g. 'Earth, Atmos & Planetary Sci', 'Tufts Cross-Enrollment Prog').

71380442ee9a7ce4.column_purpose: Concatenation of code and name ('12-Earth, Atmos & Planetary Sci'); unique, one-to-one with SIS_DEPARTMENT.col_003, so it mirrors the SIS department identifier.

4b562bdb2b7056be.column_purpose: Single-letter code for the school/area grouping the department belongs to: E = Engineering, H = Humanities/Arts/Social Sciences, S = Science, Z = Non-MIT, Y = MIT academic (e.g. Schwarzman College), T = Whitaker College of HST. Pairs with col_005.

37ad4e018e299ee4.column_purpose: Name of the school/area grouping corresponding to col_004 (Engineering; Hum, Arts & Social Sciences; Science; Non-MIT; MIT, academic; Schwarzman Coll of Comp; Whitaker Coll of HST).

0fc9bfc4a9391783.column_purpose: Primary key: composite code of race category code and subgroup code, e.g. '50:5001' = Asian:Chinese.

6d3d36a24c197fa7.column_purpose: Broad race/ethnicity category label (Asian, Hispanic or Latino, Black or African American, etc.), corresponding to the code in col_004.

b19baa0147712cab.column_purpose: Detailed subgroup within the race category: either a specific ethnicity/nationality (China, Puerto Rico, Spain, Sioux, African) or a generic label ('Other', or the category name itself when no subgroup applies).

910a09dc137d975a.column_purpose: Two-digit code for the broad race/ethnicity category (10=Black or African American, 20=American Indian or Alaskan Native, 30=Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, 40=Hispanic or Latino, 50=Asian, etc.). e174123ebe59d0b9.column_purpose: Date the row was last updated or extracted, formatted DD-MON-YY; all rows show 19-DEC-24, suggesting a snapshot date. Tentative: it could also be a data-load/refresh date rather than a per-row update date, since every row shares the same value.

1fd91d6794ec9d7d.column_purpose: Primary key: short code identifying a subject attribute (e.g. HASS, REST, Institute Lab, cross-registration flags). Values like BIOL, CAL1, ZK, NHCR are MIT subject attribute codes.

77fae936cbfc81a6.column_purpose: Short/abbreviated label for the attribute (e.g. 'HASS-A', 'Institute Lab', 'Half REST Ex'). Null for ~39% of rows, likely where no short form exists. Alternative reading: could be a display label used in the catalog UI rather than an abbreviation.

08383a026ee168e6.column_purpose: Full description/title of the attribute (e.g. 'HUM-D, Film and Media Studies', 'Not for Cross Reg Harvard', 'Spring Core, Sloan Masters').

f910687d776f6f3c.column_purpose: Date the attribute record became effective (stored as DD-MON-YY text), ranging from 1993 to 2022.

de9b34e5555beaf8.column_purpose: Date the record was last refreshed/loaded into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows, suggesting a snapshot/extract date rather than a per-row business date. 05336ca6f0c63833.column_purpose: Academic term code in the form YYYY + FA/SP (e.g. 2012FA = Fall 2012). References ACADEMIC_TERMS / ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

e5fe83913053ec21.column_purpose: Comma-separated list of subject codes (HAA.NNNN, ...), varying only by term - appears to be the full list of enrollable subject codes for that term, repeated on each row of the term.
